reuse.why: shared/schedules.ts already exports getExpectedScheduleAmount (missing -> 0, number, range end furthest from zero) used by four server paths, and the diff ignores it.

duplication.why: The nested ternary in scheduleModel.toExternal is a line-for-line copy of getExpectedScheduleAmount.

placement.why: Mapping the field in api-models.ts is right, but the amount rule itself is written in the API model layer instead of coming from shared/schedules.

scope.why: Only the API type, the model mapping and a new test file change.

maintainability.why: If the expected-amount rule changes in the shared helper, the API field will silently keep the old rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: scheduleModel.toExternal in server/api-models.ts computes the expected amount inline instead of calling getExpectedScheduleAmount from #shared/schedules.

disguised_duplication.where: The copy in api-models.ts is a direct inline restatement of the helper's dispatch, not reshaped to hide it.
